sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:127

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:127:1
items.html:
The principal illumination that AA gives to ZA is from that one other path that runs in the middle of the hair of AA, and this alone is drawn continuously to the Rosh [head] of ZA: Meaning: there are thirteen corrections: twelve of them are from three HaVaYot, which are twelve letters, as said above, and one path that includes them all, which is this one path that runs in the middle of the hair — meaning that the three HaVaYot are the nine Sefirot of the NHY of Atik, in which are the Mochin of the three heads of AA, namely HBD HGT NHY, as said above in the discernment of Mem-Lamed-Tzadi of Tzelem. And the one path that includes them is the discernment of the Malchut within this NHY, upon whose corrected screen these nine Sefirot of the NHY of Atik that clothe these Mochin came out, where the three aforementioned HaVaYot are, from below upward. Therefore it includes all the paths, for it bears the screen upon which all these nine Sefirot come out, which are three HaVaYot making twelve paths. But it too, in itself, is discerned as spreading by itself into twelve ways like the twelve that go from below upward, being the discernment of the Malchut within them, which spreads from above downward to the same extent that its reflected light spread from below upward, as is known.
And it is known that ZA is the discernment of the body of Atzilut, and AVI are its Rosh. Therefore it is discerned that the principal grip of ZA is not in the discernment of the twelve ways that go from below upward, but only in this path that runs in the middle of the hair, which is the discernment of the body that spreads from above downward. And this is what he said: “The principal illumination that AA gives to ZA is from this one path that runs in the middle of the hair.”
